version.changelog:
- Improved skill description and usage guidelines for clarity, emphasizing local, private document search only.
- Added details on supported file formats (PDF, DOCX, PPTX) and clarified the tool doesn’t perform web searches.
- Included a new workflow section for answering questions using local docs, with guidance on citing sources.
- Added error handling guidelines for common scenarios (no search results, missing paths).
- Updated install instructions and provided a link for more information.

llm.summary: This skill is a coherent local document-search helper, but users should treat its unpinned external npm CLI and broad local indexing as trust decisions.

dimensions.detail: Access to private local documents is expected for a local document search tool, and examples require explicit paths, but users should scope indexing to intended folders only.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation uses an unpinned third-party npm package, so the reviewed artifact does not lock the exact code a user will install; this is a supply-chain exposure rather than artifact-backed malicious behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The usage instructions are user-directed and limited to adding, searching, listing, checking status, and stopping the local index, but they encourage indexing private document paths and make strong privacy claims that cannot be verified from the reviewed Markdown alone.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill implies a local indexing service and persistent index through list/status/stop commands; this is disclosed and purpose-aligned, with a stop command provided.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifact consistently describes a local-first DocsAgent skill for indexing and searching user-selected PDF, DOCX, and PPTX files, and the commands shown match that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you trust the @docsagent/docsagent npm package and publisher. Prefer a pinned or audited version where possible, avoid running npm with elevated privileges, and index only the specific document folders you intend to search.
llm.findings: [T08] expected: The unpinned npm install is a real supply-chain caveat for a CLI-based skill, but the artifact does not include hidden execution, deception, exfiltration, or unrelated privilege requests; it should be handled as user guidance rather than a Review verdict by itself.
